title: Step observation characterizes core equality
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string of length $n$, and let $c,d$ be configurations of $M$ on input $x$, each with work-tape heads in the window of radius $s$ and tapes blank outside that window. The observation of the one-step successor of $c$ agrees at every encoded bit position with the encoded row of $d$ if and only if the successor of $c$ and $d$ have equal core data and output summaries.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is in the window of radius $s$
$d$ is in the window of radius $s$
